adaptations: Fixed frontal60-degree camera; source UVTween/FxDelay and deterministic particle clock replayed. Game Torappu orchestration absent; caster/target mounts supplied explicitly.

M31 and dmage original two-point LineRenderers receive caster/target endpoint fixture; runtime ShowBeam maps reference length to actual mounts. Original material/UV/line width remain.
Functional explosive-death danger radius remains a UI marker; native blasts replace old geometric burst/shards.
